subject: Agriculture
title: Methane and Climate Change
description: One-minute skill: Methane and Climate Change.

hook.text: Livestock produce 14.5% of global greenhouse gas emissions—more than all cars, planes, and ships combined.

buildup.text: Ruminants like cattle belch methane during digestion. One cow produces 100 kg of methane per year.

discovery.text: Methane is 80 times more potent than CO₂ over 20 years. Cutting methane is the fastest way to slow warming.

twist.text: A seaweed additive called Asparagopsis can reduce cattle methane by 80%—but scaling it is the challenge.

climax.text: Livestock emissions will determine whether agriculture meets its climate targets or undermines them.

punchline.text: The cow's burp is a climate problem. The fix might grow in the ocean.

quiz.question: What percentage of global greenhouse emissions comes from livestock?
